page.overview:
Who is Roy?

Roy is one of the two protagonists of . He is a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers.

As a child, Roy has rounder and softer facial features, giving him an even more youthful and innocent look compared to his older self. His eyes are still large and expressive, with bright reddish-pink irises that convey curiosity and excitement. His eyebrows are thin and slightly arched, matching his lively expressions. He has a small, rounded nose and a mouth that often forms wide, open smiles, showing his cheerful and energetic personality. His hair remains short and dark, with the same distinctive bright pink tuft at the front, which stands out as a signature part of his appearance. Overall, his face exudes playfulness and wonder, fitting for his younger age.

Roy wears a casual and playful outfit that matches his energetic personality. He has on a light green short-sleeved shirt with dark blue sleeves and collar trim, featuring a brown wing-like emblem on the chest. His shorts are knee-length and dark blue, matching the shirt's accents, and are loose enough for easy movement. On his feet, he wears dark blue sandals with bright orange straps and soles, keeping the look light and summer-ready. The most distinctive part of his appearance remains his short dark hair with the signature bright pink tuft at the front, adding a burst of color that makes him instantly recognizable.

Roy has a cheerful and expressive face that radiates enthusiasm and determination. His eyes are large, round, and a striking reddish-pink color, giving him a lively and curious appearance. He has medium-dark skin and expressive, slightly arched eyebrows that shift noticeably with his emotions. His nose is small and rounded, and his mouth is often seen in wide smiles, open shouts, or determined grins, showing his energetic personality. His hair is short and curly, predominantly dark brown but with a distinct pink tuft at the front that stands out as a unique feature. Combined with his youthful features, Roy's face conveys a sense of adventurous spirit and eagerness for new experiences.
